findings.title: View target file before every edit
findings.summary: The specialist issued an edit to Checkout.razor without first calling view to confirm the current file state. This risks generating a diff conflict on a stale base and wastes a review cycle.
findings.expected_impact: Eliminates stale-base edit errors and reduces review-cycle churn by roughly one pass per affected file.
findings.prompt_fragment: Before issuing any edit tool call, always call view on the target file first to confirm the current content. Do not assume content from prior context is still accurate.

findings.title: Confirm lane scope before delegation
findings.summary: The specialist accepted a task that partially overlapped the form-specialist lane (validation logic) without flagging the boundary. This led to the orchestrator needing to re-route mid-run.
findings.expected_impact: Reduces mid-run re-routing and keeps specialist work bounded to the declared lane contract.
findings.prompt_fragment: Before starting implementation, explicitly check whether the task touches any adjacent lane (forms, data-fetching, auth). If it does, surface the overlap in your opening summary and await orchestrator confirmation before proceeding.

findings.title: Avoid full-file rewrites for targeted changes
findings.summary: Two edits were applied by rewriting an entire 120-line component when only 8 lines changed. This bloats output tokens and makes diffs harder to review.
findings.expected_impact: Reduces output tokens and makes generated diffs self-evident without full-file context.
findings.prompt_fragment: Prefer surgical edits using old_str/new_str targeting only the changed lines. Only rewrite an entire file when the majority of lines are affected or when the file is short (< 30 lines).
